topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer therapies and their mechanisms.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and resistance mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine standard local and systemic treatment modalities, including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapies, as well as the physiological toxicities and drug efflux mechanisms that limit them.

topics.label: Targeted therapies exploiting intrinsic cancer vulnerabilities and synthetic lethality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss targeted therapeutic strategies that exploit cancer-specific biological vulnerabilities, including hormone dependence, cell cycle checkpoint loss, and synthetic lethality in DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Small-molecule kinase inhibitors and resistance pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the design and action of small-molecule inhibitors targeting hyperactivated oncogenic kinases, along with the structural mutations, bypass pathways, and drug addiction driving acquired resistance.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine antibody-based therapeutics designed to target cell-surface antigens, whether through immune effector recruitment, receptor blocking, or targeted delivery of cytotoxic toxins.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and immune-cell redirection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the principles of tumor immunology and therapies that harness or engineer the immune system, including checkpoint inhibitors, bispecific antibodies, and CAR T cells.

topics.label: Clinical progress, emerging paradigms, and future challenges in oncology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess historical improvements in cancer outcomes, the ongoing challenges of tumor heterogeneity and clinical trial design, and future priorities in cancer management.
